title: Observer: Runs that end without a PR are re-run until quarantine, whatever the run said
problem: When a run on a ticket ends without opening a pull request, the stranded-unit sweep drops the claim and puts the ticket back in the queue, even when the run left a comment explaining that nothing can be done yet. The next run reaches the same conclusion, and after three such runs the ticket is quarantined as unproductive.

title: Observer: Hosted Renovate keeps opening PRs the checks kind cannot fix
problem: Renovate opens dependency PRs whose checks fail, and the `checks` kind's idle CI fix gives up on them. Renovate's schedule should be narrowed so it opens fewer PRs.
